title: Creeper Overhaul data models for Hostile Neural Networks
description: Adds unique data models for the Creeper variants added by Creeper Overhaul which have unique drops, including the valuable Cave Creeper that can drop diamonds!
body:
This mod is an addon for [Hostile Neural Networks](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/hostile-neural-networks) that changes its compatibility with [Creeper Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/mod/creeper-overhaul). Normally, all Creepers are treated the same as Vanilla Minecraft Creepers by Hostile Neural Networks. But many of the Creeper variants added by the overhaul mod have unique, valuable drops.

With this addon, every Creeper variant that has unique drops can be simulated by Hostile Neural Networks to farm rare items in a server-friendly manner.

Designed and tested for Creeper Overhaul 4.0.6. Should work with any version of it for Minecraft 1.21.1. Release 1.2 of this pack is only compatible with Hostile Neural Networks 6.4.0 and higher. For older versions, use release 1.1.

This was mostly made for use in a modpack I'm working on, but I'm sure other people will find it useful too. If it needs changes to be compatible with other versions, you can DM me on [BlueSky](https://bsky.app/profile/voxtricity.bsky.social), or find me on Discord as voxtricitymusic.

Mod logo contains textures by Shadows_of_Fire and Joosh.
